findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Killing.lean:239-241 `noncomputable def coroot (α) := 2 • (α <| (cartanEquivDual H).symm α)⁻¹ • (cartanEquivDual H).symm α`; :390-392 `lie_eq_killingForm_smul_of_mem_rootSpace_of_mem_rootSpace_neg ... ⁅e, f⁆ = killingForm K L e f • (cartanEquivDual H).symm α`; :442 `root_apply_cartanEquivDual_symm_ne_zero`. Grep of `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/` shows no existing lemma computing this pairing, so no consumer can supply it.
findings.fix: Add `killingForm_root_neg_eq : killingForm K L (x α) (x (-α)) = 2 * (α ((cartanEquivDual H).symm α))⁻¹` (proof: rewrite `hlie` against `hx.lie_neg α hα` and `LieAlgebra.IsKilling.coroot`, then `smul_left_injective` using `(cartanEquivDual H).symm α ≠ 0`, which follows from `root_apply_cartanEquivDual_symm_ne_zero hα`), and derive `killingForm_root_neg_ne_zero` from it via `root_apply_cartanEquivDual_symm_ne_zero`. List it in `## Main results`.
findings.issue: `killingForm_root_neg_ne_zero` throws away the value it has in hand. `hlie` (line 104) gives `killingForm K L (x α) (x (-α)) • (cartanEquivDual H).symm α = coroot α`, and `coroot α = 2 • (α ((cartanEquivDual H).symm α))⁻¹ • (cartanEquivDual H).symm α` by definition, so the pairing is exactly `2 / α ((cartanEquivDual H).symm α)`. Without that equality, `structureConstant_mul_killingForm_eq` only tells a consumer that `N(α,β)` and `N(β,-γ)` agree up to an unknown nonzero ratio — i.e. it yields nonvanishing equivalence and nothing more — which is not the Humphreys §25.2 relation `N(α,β)/(γ,γ) = N(β,γ)/(α,α)` the module docstring advertises as usable downstream.

summary: Clean rename with no compatibility residue and no over-exposure, but the Killing factor in the cyclic relation is only proved nonzero, never evaluated, so the headline lemma exposes N(α,β) and N(β,-γ) as related by an unknown scalar and cannot be used to compare them.
